authorization: User requested the final two batches locally; four individual additions per batch.
change_scope: One feature added to the fixed starting model per batch.
fit_accounting: 24 new forests plus four earlier blend selections per candidate.
promotion_rule: Promote only verified lower same-row MAE. Track Spearman only. Keep compact history and discard losing model/prediction artifacts after verification.
selection_exposure: PDF ranking and previous model results were inspected. Feature selection is historical development selection, not untouched confirmation.
stopping_rule: Only the final eight eligible PDF features; combinations and other horizons deferred.
horizon_reuse: Target horizon, label-end column, input paths, folds and benchmark are explicit. Other horizons require matching target labels and separately generated/verified pair anchors and benchmark predictions. Never reuse 48h target/model artifacts for another horizon; no other horizons run in this experiment.
selection_rule: Lowest earlier inner ensemble blend MAE; tie lower RF weight.
interruption_accounting: Includes one completed but unsaved fit from interrupted attempt; one unfinished fit recorded separately in interruption_receipt.json.

execution_policy.change: Worker count only; trees, seeds, data, scoring and selection unchanged.
